resolved.title: DataFrame 创建
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]DataFrames[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Before working with real data, let's first create a DataFrame manually to explore its functions.
The easiest way to create a DataFrame is using a [b]dictionary[/b]:
[code format="py" ]data = {
   'ages': [14, 18, 24, 42],
   'heights': [165, 180, 176, 184]
} [/code]
Each key is a column, while the value is an array representing the data for that column.

Now, we can pass this dictionary to the DataFrame constructor:
[code format="py" codeId="3225"]df = pd.DataFrame(data) [/code]
[note]Run the code to see the resulting DataFrame.[/note]

resolved.title: DataFrame 行索引
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]DataFrames[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The DataFrame automatically creates a numeric [b]index[/b] for each row. 
We can specify a custom index, when creating the DataFrame:[code format="py" codeId="3226"]df = pd.DataFrame(data, index=['James', 'Bob', 'Amy', 'Dave']) [/code]
Now we can access a row using its index and the [b]loc[][/b] function:[code format="py" codeId="3227"]print(df.loc["Bob"]) [/code]This will output the row that corresponds to the index "Bob".
[note]Note, that [b]loc[/b] uses square brackets to specify the index.[/note]

content.text:
DataFrame会自动为每一行创建一个数字索引**index**。
我们可以在创建DataFrame的时候指定一个自定义的索引：
content.text_html:
The DataFrame automatically creates a numeric index for each row. We can specify a custom index, when creating the DataFrame:

DataFrame会自动为每一行创建一个数字索引。 我们可以在创建DataFrame的时候指定一个自定义的索引。

content.content:
import pandas as pd

data = {
   'ages': [14, 18, 24, 42],
   'heights': [165, 180, 176, 184]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data, index=['James', 'Bob', 'Amy', 'Dave'])
print(df)

content.text: 现在我们可以使用自定义索引和`loc[]`函数来访问一个行。
content.text_html:
Now we can access a row using its index and the loc[] function:

现在我们可以使用它的索引和**loc[]**函数来访问一个行。

content.content:
import pandas as pd

data = {
   'ages': [14, 18, 24, 42],
   'heights': [165, 180, 176, 184]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data, index=['James', 'Bob', 'Amy', 'Dave'])
print(df.loc["Bob"])

content.text: 这将输出索引"Bob"相对应的行。
content.text_html:
This will output the row that corresponds to the index "Bob".

这将输出与索引 "Bob "相对应的行。

content.text: 注意，**loc**使用方括号`[]`来指定索引。
content.text_html:
Note, that loc uses square brackets to specify the index.

注意，loc使用方括号来指定索引。

resolved.title: 查找联系人
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定代码中，包含一个联系人字典，格式为:

```python
data = {
   # 姓名
   'name': ['James', 'Billy', 'Bob', 'Amy', 'Tom'],
   # 编号
   'number': ['1234', '5678', '2222', '1111', '0909']
}
```

你需要从字典中创建一个DataFrame，并添加索引，该索引值是姓名`name`。

然后从用户输入中获取一个名字，并输出DataFrame中与该名字相对应的行。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Locating Contacts[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given a dictionary that contains names and numbers of people.
You need to create a DataFrame from the dictionary and add an index to it, which should be the name values.
Then take a name from user input and output the row in the DataFrame, which corresponds to that row.
[note]Use .[b]loc[/b] to find the specified row.[/note]

code_templates.solution_code:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

data = {
   'name': ['James', 'Billy', 'Bob', 'Amy', 'Tom'],
   'number': ['1234', '5678', '2222', '1111', '0909']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data, index = ["James", "Billy","Bob","Amy", "Tom"])

name = input()

print(df.loc[name])

testcases.expected_output:
name      James
number     1234
Name: James, dtype: object
